quests.title: A Land Entombed

dialogue.t: Seems like some sort of records left behind by someone who once investigated the area.
{NICKNAME}, Paimon bets these will be of great value— um, historical value to someone. Let's go ask around.

quests.description: You discover a strange journal in the mountains that tells of the secrets of a certain kingdom. Perhaps someone at the camp may know more about this journal…
